claims: The 2026 Masters has a total purse of $22.5 million.
The 2026 Masters purse is the largest in tournament history.
Rory McIlroy earned $4.5 million as the winner of the 2026 Masters.
Scottie Scheffler finished 2nd in the 2026 Masters.
Scottie Scheffler earned $2.43 million as runner-up in the 2026 Masters.
The top four finishers in the 2026 Masters all earned over $1 million.
Tyrrell Hatton, Russell Henley, Justin Rose, and Cameron Young finished T3 in the 2026 Masters.
Tyrrell Hatton, Russell Henley, Justin Rose, and Cameron Young each earned $1,080,000 in the 2026 Masters.
Collin Morikawa and Sam Burns finished T7 in the 2026 Masters.
Collin Morikawa and Sam Burns each earned $725,625 in the 2026 Masters.
Max Homa and Xander Schauffele finished T9 in the 2026 Masters.
Max Homa and Xander Schauffele each earned $630,000 in the 2026 Masters.
Professionals who missed the cut in the 2026 Masters received $25,000.
No amateurs made the cut in the 2026 Masters.
All top 12 finishers in the 2026 Masters earned at least $517,500.
The 2025 Masters total purse was $21 million.
